A perfect bay to learn from zero to hero or to progress your level of kiteboarding or wingfoiling. Staying in our resort combines an eco friendly lifestyle close to nature without giving up infrastructure (we have electricity, tapwater and warm watershowers and and 5G wifi- in case you are working while kiting and traveling) and a lot of sports and healthy activities. Thats how we love life and we want to share our passion and lifestyle with our guests. No coffeeshops, malls or discos- but crystall clear water, white sand beaches, reliable wind, 13 different islands to kite on and campfires at night. Away from the crowds- but still easy accesible: only 3 hours away from Boracay or 45 min by plane from Clark Airport. If you want to know how to get to us, check our travelinfos. All you need to relax and enjoy your vacation: kitesurfing, wingfoiling, mountainbiking, hiking, SUP, yoga, freediving, massage- you can have it all for yourself."/>

<br class="cc-clear"/>

</div><div id="cc-m-6110923318" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-6110923318">If you are an Outdoorlover- this is your place!</h1></div><div id="cc-m-6110925318" class="j-module n j-hr ">    <hr/>
</div><div id="cc-m-6110926018" class="j-module n j-hgrid ">    <div class="cc-m-hgrid-column" style="width: 66.56%;">
        <div id="cc-matrix-1446734818"><div id="cc-m-6187886718" class="j-module n j-header "><h2 class="" id="cc-m-header-6187886718">Wing, Kite, SUP Yoga, Freedive &amp; a lot more</h2></div><div id="cc-m-6187887218" class="j-module n j-text "><p>
    Discover Mindoro by kite and jump from your bed on your board to go on downwindtrips or just enjoy the shallow water area in front of our door. A perfect bay to learn from zero to hero or to
    progress your level of kiteboarding or wingfoiling.
</p>

<p>
    Staying in our resort combines an eco friendly lifestyle close to nature without giving up <em>infrastructure (we have electricity, tapwater and warm watershowers and and 5G wifi- in case you are
    working while kiting and traveling)</em> and a lot of sports and healthy activities. Thats how we love life and we want to share our passion and lifestyle with our guests.
</p>

<p>
     
</p>

<p>
    No coffeeshops, malls or discos- but crystall clear water, white sand beaches, reliable wind, 13 different islands to kite on and campfires at night. Away from the crowds- but still easy
    accesible: only 3 hours away from Boracay or 45 min by plane from Clark Airport. If you want to know how to get to us, check our <strong><a href="/about/" title="About">travelinfos.</a></strong>
</p>

<p>
    All you need to relax and enjoy your vacation: kitesurfing, wingfoiling, mountainbiking, hiking, SUP, yoga, freediving, massage- you can have it all for yourself. 
</p></div></div>    </div>
